How the Bazar Works?

Four simple steps, an unforgettable lesson in profit & commerce

01

Choose Your Product

Every child decides what they want to sell

02

Set Up Your Stall

Design, arrange, and display your way

03

Start Selling

Negotiate, convince, and close the deal

04

Count Your Profits

Learn from results and start again

What Your Child Learns in Their Mini-Store

Pitch & Sell

Children learn how to present their product with confidence and convince others of its value.

Money Management

A practical introduction to pricing, profit, and cost concepts — in a way children understand.

Negotiation

The art of reaching a mutually beneficial agreement — a skill every successful person needs.

Entrepreneurial Thinking

From idea to product to sale — children live the complete entrepreneurship cycle.

Customer Service

How do you deal with a customer? How do you build a relationship? How do you serve with excellence?

Building Confidence

The real market gives children real confidence — not from books, but from direct experience.

Where human excellence begins. We equip children with the skills and experiences successful people need.

Where Children Become Leaders.
